description: 0 < x < 3, ascending-series region, tiny to moderate arguments
3 <= x < 20, Neumann-series region (includes zeros of Y_0 and Y_1)
x >= 20, Hankel-expansion region, up to 1e15 (O(1) cost)
n >= x >= 1, where |Y_n| grows with n (forward recurrence is stable)
1 <= n < x <= 5000, oscillatory region (recurrence through the oscillation)
x within a few n^(1/3) of the transition point x = n
n = 0, 1 on a dense grid: linear 0.075 <= x <= 29.925 and log-spaced 1e-3 <= x <= 1e5
